summary: MAGIC LENS end-to-end verified — backend + frontend. Backend (5/5 pytest passing in ~4s incl. real AI OCR call): /api/auth/dev-bypass returns session_token; /api/magic-lens with a PIL-generated lab-result JPEG returned found=true with non-empty extracted_text, plain-language summary, detected_category='lab_results' → lifecard_category='exam', suggested_title populated; empty image_base64 → 400; missing auth → 401; /api/calendar/events POST → 200 with event_id, GET /api/calendar/timeline contains it, DELETE removes it (verified). Frontend (mobile 390x844, all steps green): founder-bypass-btn → home shows home-welcome-banner and gold home-magic-lens tile positioned BELOW banner (banner y=164, tile y=223); tapping routes to /magic-lens; intro renders 'Point me at any health document.', ml-open-camera + ml-pick + ml-back all present; ml-back returns to home; Healing tab → hh-lifecard-hero → /health-timeline shows lc-magic-lens button in actions row and tapping it navigates to /magic-lens. Camera capture NOT tested on web preview per instructions (no real camera in headless). Founder demo Life Card data preserved (created event deleted). No red-screen errors. Only console noise: benign RN-web deprecation warnings ('shadow*', 'textShadow*', props.pointerEvents) and expo-notifications 'not fully supported on web' — pre-existing, not introduced by Magic Lens.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings on web preview: 'shadow*' → boxShadow, 'textShadow*' → textShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents. Not a regression from Magic Lens; app-wide.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Migrate deprecated RN-web style props to their non-deprecated equivalents to clean up console.
No functional fixes required for Magic Lens — safe to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/health.py magic_lens: LlmChat call is wrapped in try/except → on parse error returns 502; consider also catching JSONDecodeError and falling back to found=false with the raw text to avoid a hard failure when AI returns near-valid JSON.
magic_lens accepts data-URL prefix by splitting on ',' — good; but the 20MB base64 cap comment says '~15MB' — cosmetic mismatch only.
frontend magic-lens.tsx: 'analyze' catches all errors generically; consider surfacing HTTP 400/401 distinctly for better senior UX (rare edge case).
health.py is 1959 lines — well beyond 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into vault/, lifecard/, cabinet/ modules (pre-existing, not part of this feature).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test event created via /api/calendar/events was deleted in the same test to keep founder demo Life Card clean.
